references.text: Describes the actual event when the Lord struck the Nile, which verse 25 refers back to with the expression 'after the Lord had struck the Nile'
Shows a similar time pattern of seven days in connection with the plagues in Egypt
Seven days as a significant period of time in God's actions, here in connection with the flood
Seven days used as a completed time period, parallel to the seven days after the Nile was struck
Both verses illustrate God's pattern of giving a seven-day waiting period before carrying out a great judgment.
